title: Non-asymptotic Estimation of Sparse Partial Correlation via Joint Partial Regression
abstract: arXiv:2502.08414v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Partial correlation analysis is widely used in modern multivariate analysis. However, prior methods lack non-asymptotic guarantees and have slow asymptotic estimation rates. We present a method for simultaneously estimating sparse high-dimensional partial correlation matrices and inverse covariance with non-asymptotic rates. The method is a two-stage estimation which exploits the connection between the inverse covariance matrix and linear regression estimation method while enforcing positive semi-definiteness simultaneously. An efficient proximal splitting algorithm for numerically computing the estimate is also derived, and we provide a fast implementation of the algorithm. The effectiveness of the proposed method is demonstrated on both synthetic and real-world data.

translated_title: 基于联合偏回归的稀疏偏相关非渐近估计
translated_abstract: 偏相关分析在现代多变量分析中被广泛应用。然而，以往的方法缺乏非渐近保证，且渐近估计速率较慢。我们提出了一种方法，能够以非渐近速率同时估计稀疏的高维偏相关矩阵和逆协方差矩阵。该方法是一种两阶段估计方法，它利用了逆协方差矩阵与线性回归估计方法之间的联系，并同时强制保证矩阵的半正定性。我们还推导了一种高效的近端分裂算法用于数值计算估计值，并提供了该算法的快速实现。所提出方法的有效性在合成数据和真实世界数据上均得到了验证。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种两阶段联合偏回归估计方法，能够以非渐近速率同时估计稀疏高维偏相关矩阵与逆协方差矩阵，并同时保证半正定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage joint partial regression method that simultaneously estimates sparse high-dimensional partial correlation matrices and inverse covariance with non-asymptotic rates, while enforcing positive semi-definiteness.
